name: REC_SIMPLE_COUNTER_UNION_ALL
description: Simple recursive counter 1..10 with UNION ALL preserves rows
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<10
)
SELECT x FROM n;

name: REC_COUNTER_UNION_DEDUPES
description: Recursive counter with UNION (not UNION ALL) terminates when duplicates emerge
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION SELECT (x % 3) + 1 FROM n
)
SELECT x FROM n ORDER BY x;

name: REC_GRAPH_CYCLE_DETECT_NOT_IN
description: Cycle detection via WHERE NOT IN visited set
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE edge(a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
INSERT INTO edge VALUES (1,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,4);
WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, path) AS (
  SELECT 1, '1'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.b, w.path || '->' || e.b
  FROM edge e JOIN walk w ON e.a = w.node
  WHERE ',' || w.path || ',' NOT LIKE '%,' || e.b || ',%'
        AND w.path NOT LIKE e.b || '->%'
        AND w.path NOT LIKE '%->' || e.b
        AND w.path <> CAST(e.b AS TEXT)
)
SELECT node, path FROM walk ORDER BY path;

name: REC_MULTI_TWO_RECURSIVE_CTES
description: Two recursive CTEs in same WITH RECURSIVE block
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH RECURSIVE
  evens(x) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT x+2 FROM evens WHERE x<10),
  odds(y)  AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT y+2 FROM odds  WHERE y<10)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM evens) AS ec,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM odds)  AS oc,
       (SELECT sum(x) FROM evens)   AS es,
       (SELECT sum(y) FROM odds)    AS os;

name: REC_MATERIALIZED_HINT
description: Non-recursive CTE with MATERIALIZED hint produces same result as plain CTE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH base(x) AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value FROM (SELECT 1 AS value UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3)
)
SELECT x, x*x FROM base ORDER BY x;

name: REC_MUTUAL_REFERENCE_NON_RECURSIVE
description: One CTE references another CTE (mutual non-recursive chaining)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH
  a(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
  b(y) AS (SELECT x*10 FROM a),
  c(z) AS (SELECT y+1 FROM b)

name: REC_PIVOT_STYLE_STRING_AGG
description: Recursive CTE building pivot-style concatenated string per group
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE log(grp TEXT, ord INTEGER, msg TEXT);
INSERT INTO log VALUES
  ('a',1,'x'),('a',2,'y'),('a',3,'z'),
  ('b',1,'p'),('b',2,'q');
WITH RECURSIVE acc(grp, ord, s) AS (
  SELECT grp, ord, msg FROM log WHERE ord=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.grp, l.ord, a.s || ',' || l.msg
  FROM log l JOIN acc a ON l.grp = a.grp AND l.ord = a.ord + 1
)
SELECT grp, s FROM acc a1
WHERE ord = (SELECT max(ord) FROM acc a2 WHERE a2.grp = a1.grp)
ORDER BY grp;

name: REC_COLLATZ_LIKE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH RECURSIVE c(step, x) AS (
  SELECT 0, 7
  UNION ALL
  SELECT step+1, CASE WHEN x%2=0 THEN x/2 ELSE 3*x+1 END
  FROM c WHERE x<>1
)
SELECT step, x FROM c;
